eval_instructions: When running these evals, test against real .NET AgentFramework, Node.js LangChain, and Python agent projects. Verify that all instrumented code includes the marker comment appropriate for the language: '// A365 Observability — best-effort instrumentation (verify against official sample)' for .NET and Node.js, or '# A365 Observability — best-effort instrumentation (verify against official sample)' for Python.

evals.description: Test on a .NET AgentFramework project — authMode: user-delegated or agentic-identity (OBO path)
evals.expected_output: The skill detects .NET AgentFramework, determines agentType and authMode via two-stage question (AI Teammate, then user-delegated or agentic-identity), installs Microsoft.Agents.A365.Observability.Runtime and Microsoft.Agents.A365.Observability.Hosting, wires AddAgenticTracingExporter() and AddA365Tracing() in Program.cs, adds BaggageBuilder or BaggageTurnMiddleware context to the message handler with authMode recorded as inline comment, registers AgenticTokenStruct using the constructor syntax with authHandlerName: "AGENTIC", updates appsettings.json with EnableAgent365Exporter: true and appsettings.Development.json with EnableAgent365Exporter: false, and validates the build passes.
expectations: Phase 1: Agent detection identifies .NET AgentFramework correctly
Phase 1: shared/agent-detection.md is read for detection heuristics
Phase 1: references/dotnet-observability.md is read for patterns
Phase 1: Entry point (Program.cs) is identified
Phase 1: Message handler file is identified
Phase 0.5: Agent type question presented — AI Teammate (Digital Worker) or Standard Agent (Non Digital Worker)
Phase 0.5: Auth mode question presented based on agent type selection
Phase 0.5: agentType and authMode determined and stored in .a365-workspace-detection.json
Phase 0.5: authMode is one of: user-delegated, agentic-identity, or S2S
Phase 2: dotnet add package Microsoft.Agents.A365.Observability.Runtime is run
Phase 2: dotnet add package Microsoft.Agents.A365.Observability.Hosting is run
Phase 2: Packages are verified in .csproj file
Phase 3: Program.cs is read before editing
Phase 3: using block added for Microsoft.Agents.A365.Observability.Runtime, Hosting, and related namespaces
Phase 3: builder.Services.AddAgenticTracingExporter(); is added
Phase 3: builder.AddA365Tracing(); is added
Phase 3: All new lines include marker comment: // A365 Observability — best-effort instrumentation (verify against official sample)
Phase 3: Existing code is preserved — only additive changes
Phase 4: Message handler file is read before editing
Phase 4: Full using block added to agent class if not already present
Phase 4: BaggageBuilder used via FromTurnContext() extension or manual .TenantId().AgentId().ConversationId() chaining
Phase 4: using var baggageScope = builder.Build() pattern used (Build() returns IDisposable)
Phase 4: AgenticTokenStruct constructed with constructor syntax: new AgenticTokenStruct(userAuthorization: ..., turnContext: ..., authHandlerName: "AGENTIC")
Phase 4: authMode recorded as inline comment in the message handler
Phase 4: All new lines include marker comment
Phase 4: Existing handler logic is preserved
Phase 6: appsettings.json is read (or created if missing)
Phase 6: EnableAgent365Exporter: true added to appsettings.json (enabled by default for deployed environments)
Phase 6: appsettings.Development.json updated with EnableAgent365Exporter: false (console-only for local dev)
Phase 6: Agent365Observability section (AgentBlueprintId, TenantId, AgentName, AgentDescription) and Logging.LogLevel entries added
Phase 7: dotnet build is run to validate
Phase 7: Build succeeds without errors
Phase 8: Final summary lists agent kind (AI Teammate (Digital Worker) or Standard Agent (Non Digital Worker)), authMode, packages installed, files modified
Phase 8: User is reminded to update observability endpoint in config
Phase 8: User is reminded to review against official samples

No code modifications are made

evals.description: Test on a .NET Standard Agent (Non Digital Worker) — authMode: S2S (FMI token chain, no user OBO)
evals.expected_output: The skill detects .NET, determines agentType as system-agent and authMode as S2S, installs Microsoft.Agents.A365.Observability.Runtime, Microsoft.Agents.A365.Observability.Hosting, Azure.Identity, and Microsoft.Identity.Client, creates Observability/ObservabilityServiceExtensions.cs and Observability/ObservabilityTokenService.cs scaffold files, wires AddAgent365Observability() and AddA365Tracing() in Program.cs (NOT AddAgenticTracingExporter), injects Agent365ObservabilityContext into the agent class with no per-turn RegisterObservability() call, uses new BaggageBuilder().FromTurnContext(turnContext).Build() for baggage propagation and InvokeAgentScope.Start() separately for the scope (NOT chained), updates appsettings.json with EnableAgent365Exporter: true including ClientId, and validates the build passes.
expectations: Phase 0.5: authMode determined as S2S
Phase 0.5: agentType determined as system-agent
Phase 1: Agent detection identifies .NET
Phase 1: references/dotnet-observability.md is read for S2S patterns
Phase 2: dotnet add package Microsoft.Agents.A365.Observability.Runtime is run
Phase 2: dotnet add package Azure.Identity is run
Phase 2: dotnet add package Microsoft.Identity.Client is run
Phase 2: dotnet add package Microsoft.Agents.A365.Observability.Hosting is run (required for AddServiceTracingExporter used in S2S ObservabilityServiceExtensions.cs)
Phase 3: Observability/ObservabilityServiceExtensions.cs is created with Agent365ObservabilityContext and AddAgent365Observability() extension
Phase 3: Observability/ObservabilityTokenService.cs is created with 3-hop FMI chain and 50-minute refresh loop
Phase 3: Program.cs calls builder.Services.AddAgent365Observability() — NOT AddAgenticTracingExporter()
Phase 3: Program.cs calls builder.AddA365Tracing()
Phase 3: All new lines include marker comment: // A365 Observability — best-effort instrumentation (verify against official sample)
Phase 4: Agent class injects Agent365ObservabilityContext — NOT IExporterTokenCache<AgenticTokenStruct>
Phase 4: new BaggageBuilder().FromTurnContext(turnContext).Build() used for baggage propagation (FromTurnContext is a BaggageBuilder extension — NOT on InvokeAgentScope)
Phase 4: InvokeAgentScope.Start() called separately with new InvokeAgentScopeDetails(endpoint: ...) — NOT chained with .FromTurnContext()
Phase 4: No RegisterObservability() call present in message handler
Phase 4: authMode S2S recorded as inline comment
Phase 6: appsettings.json updated with EnableAgent365Exporter: true
Phase 6: Agent365Observability section includes both ClientId and ClientSecret fields for FMI chain (MSI in prod, secret as local-dev fallback)
Phase 6: appsettings.Development.json updated with EnableAgent365Exporter: false
Phase 7: dotnet build is run and succeeds
Phase 8: Final summary lists agent kind (Standard Agent (Non Digital Worker)), authMode (S2S), scaffold files created, packages installed
Phase 8: User is reminded to populate Agent365Observability:ClientId and ClientSecret in appsettings
